description: The conformance corpus. Every loader and validator runs these: valid files must load, invalid ones must be refused with the named code. Warnings are advisory and listed so validators agree on them.

codes.version: version missing, not an integer, or newer than 1
codes.schema: structure the schema rejects: a missing field, a wrong type, a reserved or unknown kind
codes.ref.token: a shape names a token that neither the local palette nor any palette_ref could supply
codes.ref.part: a state names a part the document does not have
codes.tris: tris is not index triples, or an index is past the last point
codes.dup.token: two local tokens share a name

warnings.unknown: an unknown field, preserved but meaningless to this version
warnings.reserved: a field or value this version reserves for later (children, clips, constraints, space)
warnings.unresolved: a palette_ref could not be read, so token references were not checked

cases.note: a palette file: tokens only, one with an additive field this version ignores
the whole kit: a ref, local tokens, parts, anchors, states that reorder and re-pose, collision, meta
a concave poly with no tris; loaders may triangulate or fan
parts without shapes yet, states already posing them
fields from the future: preserved, ignored, warned about
names are strings, strings are unicode
a version-1 reader must refuse a newer major
ring is reserved, not yet a kind
a drawn shape names a token; only collision shapes may skip it
a hex string is not a token; the validator sees a token nothing supplies
